watch.summary: The streamer praises a young Valorant pro player by hyperbolically claiming he must be an AI trained on all the best IGLs.

beats.what: Creator watches VCT Americas footage featuring an 18-year-old IGL.
Creator questions how an 18-year-old can be both an IGL and an insane fragger.
Creator humorously claims the player is AI, not a human being.
Creator lists top IGLs and jokes the player was trained on all their dataset.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: That's AI! That's not a human being, that's AI!
watch.why: The creator uses mild hyperbolic commentary to compliment a young esports prodigy by calling him AI. It functions more as esports hype and praise than traditional comedy.
